title: A variable read of a memstore entity is a reader: no copy product and no role pair
proves: a producer writes target="mem,CSV" and a later step reads every stored row with a <variable source="mem" storage="data">: Build is ready without a copy generate
the variable read works in an included step and inside a <condition>
a memstore that nothing reads, by <generate source> or by <variable source>, is rejected and the remediation names the variable read
a variable that reads an entity no product writes (a misspelled sourceEntity) is rejected before execution
a script that changes the memstore after the producer wrote it (mem.consume) is rejected at the producer: the store no longer holds the captured rows

negatives.name: memstore_nothing_reads
negatives.remediation: read them with <variable name="rows" source="mem" sourceEntity="accounts" storage="data" distribution="ordered"/>

patch.old:
<!-- 90 report: one row that reads every stored account -->
    <include uri="delivery/90_report.xml"/>

negatives.name: variable_reads_a_misspelled_entity
negatives.message: No product writes the memstore entity

patch.new:
<generate name="tamper" count="1" target="ConsoleExporter">
        <key name="done" script="mem.consume(('accounts', [{'account_id': 99}])) is None"/>
    </generate>
    <include uri="delivery/90_report.xml"/>

<condition><if condition="True">
            <variable name="all_accounts" source="mem" sourceEntity="accounts" storage="data" distribution="ordered"/>
        </if></condition>
